items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 27 September 2026 4:53pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 27 September 2026 at 4:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure covers the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Westerly 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the east at first, backing southwesterly 3 or 4 overnight, then backing south tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, decreasing slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first, then fair.


##Visibility##

Mainly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South, backing southeast, 3 or 4, increasing 5 or 6 overnight into Tuesday, then 6 or 7 on Tuesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate, then moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
